text:
zoe: deploybot called out a canary latency uptick after the v3.8.0 rollout in us-west-2. autopilot suppressed due to config "require-operator". who wants to take lead?

harry: i'm looking. p95 +260ms on generator path, canary slice 5%. no 5xxs.

ops-bot: snapshot: region=usw2 canary=5% p95_delta=+260ms error_rate=0.6% host_restart=0

maria: preference = fast safe path. options: (A) manual revert to v3.7.5, (B) short hotfix build to toggle scheduler flag (30-50m). If customers are impacted, revert.

zoe: agree. set criteria: sustained p95 delta >200ms for 4m AND operator ack. comms owner required before exec.

harry: i'll be operator if needed. command for revert: `/deploy revert --to v3.7.5 --operator harry --reason "canary latency regression"`

comms: i'll prep a two-line customer note ready to send: "We restored the previous stable version in one region after a latency regression was detected in a canary slice. No data loss; follow-up investigation underway."

legal-bot: suggested wording: avoid the word "rollback" externally. fine to say "restored previous stable version".

zoe: operator handshake: @harry you confirm? maria, stand by to test a hotfix if we later decide to patch and re-roll.

harry: confirmed. executing in 15s.

deploybot: Request received: revert to v3.7.5. Running prechecks...

deploybot: Prechecks OK  artifact v3.7.5 verified, migrations none. Initiating revert plan: remove canary -> demote v3.8.0 -> restore v3.7.5. ETA ~3m.

harry: ran `/deploy revert --to v3.7.5 --operator harry --reason "canary latency regression"`  acknowledged.

deploybot: Revert in progress: demoting canary pool. Monitoring p95 and qps.

deploybot: Revert complete. rollout state: active=v3.7.5 inactive=v3.8.0 canary=0%

ops-bot: p95 back to baseline within 90s. region us-west-2 stable.

maria: opened REL-7342 to track scheduler heuristic regression and hotfix plan. will reproduce on staging and validate long-context suite before any re-roll.

comms: sent internal note to #customer-success and queued external-line per legal guidance.

zoe: post-rollback checklist: ops monitor 24h, maria+harry own root cause + patch, comms to finalize customer message. closing thread unless new signals. :white_check_mark:
